# AE Tax Advisors Illustrative Scenarios
> A library of clearly labeled illustrative tax scenarios and worked examples from AE Tax Advisors. All scenarios are composite hypotheticals, not real clients or results.

## About
AE Tax Advisors Illustrative Scenarios is an educational library of composite hypothetical scenarios and worked examples covering cost segregation, entity restructuring, equipment expensing, exit planning, high-income professional planning, multi-state issues, prior-year amendments, real estate professional status, retirement plans, and short-term rentals. No scenario describes a real client, and no outcome is guaranteed or typical.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://aetaxadvisorscasestudies.com/
- All guides: https://aetaxadvisorscasestudies.com/guides/
